tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search the jobs that match the user's résumé and filters, best match first, a page at a time. Leaves out jobs already applied to unless include_applied is true, and postings open only to nationals unless the profile lists a nationality or nationals_only says otherwise. Reads only.

tools.name: list_saved_jobs
tools.description: The jobs the user saved, with each one's match assessment, best match first or newest first, a page at a time. Reads only.

tools.name: set_job_saved
tools.description: Saves one job to the user's saved jobs, or removes it, and returns the job with its match assessment.

tools.name: set_job_feedback
tools.description: Skips a job or restores a skipped job. Skipping cancels a swipe only if it has not yet been queued; it does not cancel an already queued application.

tools.name: list_blocked_companies
tools.description: The employers the user excluded from matches, by name, with when each was excluded; a page at a time. Reads only.

tools.name: set_company_blocked
tools.description: Excludes one employer from the user's matches, or removes its exclusion, and returns the full list of excluded employers.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: The full posting, the match assessment against the user, and any application status. Reads only.

tools.name: get_jobs
tools.description: Up to 20 postings by id with their match assessments, descriptions shortened; ids not found come back in missing. Reads only.

tools.name: get_job_from_link
tools.description: Reads the posting at an employer or job-board link and returns the full posting text, the match assessment against the user and the job id, keeping it in the user's saved jobs. Fetches the employer's page; applies to nothing.

tools.name: search
tools.description: The same matching search as search_jobs, best match first, as citable results: each job's id, its title and employer, and the employer's posting URL; fetch reads one in full. Reads only.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one job from search, with its posting URL and match details, for citing it. Reads only.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: The user's applications, newest first, with status and the employer's receipt when sent. status needs_you keeps those waiting on the user, uncertain those sent without a confirmed receipt (never sent again); started_by_this_client keeps those this assistant started. Reads only.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: One application: status and step (blocked with its reason and retry_at while ApplySent waits to retry), receipt, the answers sent, any open questions, suggested_next_tool and poll_after_seconds. Reads only.

tools.name: get_application_board
tools.description: The Applications board under its filters: how many applications stand in each bucket, how many are being worked on now, and light rows of one bucket's page or of the first rows of every bucket, work running now first. Paging with offset needs bucket. Reads only.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Receipt-confirmed application metrics for a window of UTC days: confirmations, their daily and rolling 30-day counts, and the rolling interview rate; internal AI spend is left out. Reads only.

tools.name: get_application_review
tools.description: Everything needed to review one application before it is sent: the packet revision and its approval, the documents (name, format, size, hash) and form answers it would send, open employer questions, every blocker in words, field errors and the public timeline. Use it when the user wants to check or

tools.name: get_application_receipt
tools.description: The employer's confirmation evidence for one application: the receipt, the answers sent, the proof files and the confirmation screenshot as an image when one was captured. Reads only.

tools.name: list_pending_questions
tools.description: Questions employers asked that only the user can answer; the applications asking them wait. Each is asked once and its answer is reused for every application asking it. Each group gives its batch_id, the application, its questions and how many applications ask each. Reads only.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: How many applications the account has left and has sent today (or unlimited), and anything stopping applications from being sent. Reads only.

tools.name: get_profile_status
tools.description: What the user's ApplySent profile still needs before applications can go out, and how many employer questions wait. Reports what is missing, not the values. Reads only.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: Employer emails in the user's application inbox, newest first, classified (interview, rejection, verification, assessment...) and linked to the application they belong to. Reads only; nothing is sent.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: One email from the application inbox with its text and the application it belongs to. Reads only.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: The conversation around one email: every email of the same application, or of the same sender and subject when it belongs to none, oldest first. Each message gives its id, sender, subject, received time, category and the application it belongs to, without bodies. Reads only.

tools.name: get_notification_settings
tools.description: The user's push categories and email and Telegram notification preferences, as the app and site show them. Reads only.

tools.name: update_notification_settings
tools.description: Changes only the given notification preferences and returns the saved settings.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: The user's notification feed, newest first, a page at a time, with coverage saying what was left out. Reads only.

tools.name: mark_notification_opened
tools.description: Records the first opening of a notification. Repeating it changes nothing.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Saves the given answer to one open question and applies it to every application asking it; those applications then continue. The answer is stored exactly as given, as the user's own words or the option they chose. Returns the applications answered and those now ready to continue. Sends nothing.

tools.name: preview_tailored_resume
tools.description: The résumé tailored to one job, as the PDF an application would attach, with what changed against the saved résumé. Made once with an AI model from facts already in the résumé, then reused; nothing is sent.

tools.name: approve_tailored_resume
tools.description: Marks the previewed tailored résumé (by its resume_sha256) as the one to send with this job's application. Sends nothing.

tools.name: regenerate_tailored_resume
tools.description: Discards the job's tailored résumé and its approval, then tailors it again with an AI model from the saved résumé, and returns the new résumé with what changed. Refused once the application was sent or is sending.

tools.name: preview_application
tools.description: Shows what applying to one job would send and use, and returns a single-use confirmation_token for apply_to_job. The user must review this preview and say yes in the conversation before apply_to_job; the token works for this job and this connection only and expires after 10 minutes. Sends nothing.

tools.name: queue_application_for_review
tools.description: Prepares one application for the user to review and approve in ApplySent; it is sent only after the user approves it there. Sends nothing. Refuses if a send is already in progress or the posting has already been sent.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Sends one real application to one job on the employer's site, only after the user said yes to this job in the conversation, and uses one application from the account's allowance. Requires the confirmation_token preview_application returned for this job. A job already applied to, or sent with an unce

tools.name: cancel_application
tools.description: Stops an application whose send has not started; it can then never be sent and its open questions are withdrawn. Refused once sending started.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_application_review, list_inbox, get_message, get_thread, get_notification_settings, list_notifications · Private data: get_application_review, get_application_receipt, mark_notification_opened, preview_application · Public sink: get_application_review, get_message, get_thread, get_notification_settings, approve_tailored_resume, preview_application, queue_application_for_review, cancel_application · Destructive: get_application_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_application_review, list_inbox, get_message, get_thread, get_notification_settings, list_notifications · Private data: get_application_review, get_application_receipt, mark_notification_opened, preview_application · Public sink: get_application_review, get_message, get_thread, get_notification_settings, approve_tailored_resume, preview_application, queue_application_for_review, cancel_application · Destructive: get_application_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
